title: acre-gui ignores SIGTERM
body: A release build of acre-gui at e8db7f9, open in a decade scratch pane, stayed running after `kill` sent it SIGTERM. Its state stayed `S (sleeping)`, and `kill -9` ended it. Nobody has looked for the cause, or checked whether the egui viewer did the same.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/cac6cd1d
notes.text: The cause is in decade, filed as decade-e0689c. acre-gui started by decade's `scratch.open` has `SigBlk: 0x4002` in `/proc/<pid>/status`, so SIGINT and SIGTERM are blocked and never delivered. decade blocks both for its calloop signal sources, and its children inherit the mask. Neither acre nor una installs a signal handler or sets a mask. acre-gui could unblock both at startup, but that would hide decade's bug, so this waits on decade-e0689c.
